in_sanskrit.name: Chahat
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Longing, Passion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chahat एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Chahat is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'chah' meaning 'to desire'. The name evokes a deep sense of longing and passion, reflecting the intensity and depth of one's emotions. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of desire is known as 'Rati', and Chahat is believed to be an embodiment of her essence.

in_hindi.name: चहत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Chahat is derived from the Hindi words ‘चाहना’ (chāhana) which means ‘to desire, to long for’. The name can be interpreted as one who is desiring or longing for something.
